title: My sketch of part of my mall world
content: My mall world 🌎 has several distinct neighborhoods around it, and two big cities now. In this old drawing I tried to make of how it all fits together I only had one big city. The area to the far right is where the most mall-like area is, with stores and a bookstore I’ve visited several times. But to the bottom left there’s more of an outdoor market-like mall. More walkable.
